numberOfThreads.description: deciding how many batches to create

endId.description: end id representing how many timeseries we want to create

enabled.description: if this is disabled no data will be created

timeseriesType.description: timeseries type for which you want to create data

isExactDim.description: is the field an exact dimension

iterations.description: no of days to create data for

isInitialLoad.description: determines whether the batch job is for initial load or incremental, also decides, whether we should be doing refreshNormalization, or wait for NormalizationQueue to compute

noOfIncrementalDays.description: no of incremental days which will be fired 1 day at a time

targetObjId.description: job id for the batch job

isConcurrencyTest.description: set to true for concurrency test

validateAfterCreate.description: issue a tsEval for random time-range and validate
